description.value:
Adapter casings that merge two (Dual) or three (Tri) arrows, bullets, shells or slugs into one round with all their effects. If any part deals no damage, the round deals none (other effects still apply). A box of 10; the included jig fills all 10 as an Action, or one round per Action by hand. Single use. Firing them drops the gun one Quality tier (a Poor gun is Destroyed, repairable); Foregrips and Laser Sights still help from the lowered tier.

Cost: 50eb (Costly) /10 Dual • 250eb /10 Tri (price per 10)

Item Compendium (2070) • Ammo & Explosives
